items.context: OSGeo GeoServer — OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
items.notes: OsGeo GeoServer contains an XML injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause the server to read local text files accessible to the GeoServer process or fetch attacker-specified HTTP or HTTPS URLs via a crafted ID parameter in the WFS 2.0 GetFeatureById stored query

items.context: OSGeo GeoServer — OSGeo GeoServer Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.notes: GeoServer contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass service-level role checks and invoke operations protected solely by those checks via a request with a prefixed service parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-12924

items.context: Drupal Core — Drupal Core Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
items.notes: Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.
